title: Breaking Through to Breakthrough
description: Get ready to believe in the impossible and discover the incredible breakthroughs that God has in store for your life. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals how to overcome seemingly insurmountable obstacles and tap into the unlimited potential that God has placed within you. From the story of Abraham to the mighty David, Pastor Chris shows you how to count it done and claim the victories that God has already spoken over you.
